background.$description: The bar is transparent and floats over the hero: the white is carried by the nav inside it.

default.$description: The height the header renders at with the menu folded, the menu button and the paddings around it ($header-height-mobile was 94px). The hero slides under the header by this much, see theme/components/hero.css.

expand.$description: $header-height, once the menu is inline. Swapped in at --header-expand by theme/layouts/header.css.

borderRadius.$description: 2.75rem, the pill the nav is drawn as.

shadow.$description: A soft shadow lifting the pill off the page it floats over.

inline.$description: $gutter-mobile 1.875rem on both sides of the pill.

shadow.$description: No shadow under the transparent bar once it sticks.
